purpose: Pinned official lean4export NDJSON streams cited by `imported-kernel-lean` facts in artifacts/facts/. A fact that names a stream must be able to name the exact bytes, the producing Lean toolchain, and the exporter revision -- an export without its producing revision is unreproducible, the same defect class the claim ledger's `instance-pin` exists to prevent.

producer.exporter_commit_note: Read from the clone that built the binary (`git rev-parse HEAD`), 2026-08-15. Upstream has moved on: lean4export HEAD was `leanprover/lean4:v4.34.0-rc1` as of 2026-08-10, so this pin is four Lean releases behind and the streams below must be re-exported, not assumed forward-compatible.
producer.license: Apache-2.0 (lean4export and the Lean 4 core library it exports)

reproduction.working_directory: a lean4export checkout at the pinned commit, built with `lake build` under the pinned toolchain
reproduction.determinism: Verified 2026-08-15: each stream below re-exported byte-identically on a second invocation (sha256 unchanged).
reproduction.notes: `Init` alone suffices for all five declarations; no `Std` or Mathlib import is needed. The exporter emits the requested constant plus its transitive dependency closure, so each file is a self-contained dependency-closed slice.

streams.purpose: Capability regression fixture, NOT the evidence for a fact. `Nat.add_comm` is already proved in our own kernel (`F:nat-add-comm`, proof_route kernel-lean, and it is one of the 119 theorems `nat_theorem_inventory` prints), so importing it adds no proposition to the ledger -- the same check that made the previous lane withdraw an imported `Nat.not_succ_le_zero`. What it does pin is a kernel capability: this stream is the `Nat.brecOn`/`Nat.below`/`Nat.add.match_1`/`Nat.add._f` compilation of structural recursion, and until `Proj`/`Proj` congruence landed in `def_eq` our kernel could not admit it at all. See crates/axeyum-lean-import/tests/brecon_reduction.rs.

ADR-0603 row 4 (labeled import) for IVT. The FIRST stream in this corpus sourced from Mathlib rather than Lean's own `Init`/`Std` -- exported with the full transitive dependency closure of `intermediate_value_Icc` at mathlib4 commit c5ea00351c28e24afc9f0f84379aa41082b1188f (general topology: `ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder`, `OrderTopology`, `DenselyOrdered`, `ContinuousOn`, `Set.image`, ...). All 3585 admitted declarations pass `Kernel::add_declaration` with ZERO declines.

ADR-0603 row 4 (labeled import) for EVT. Sourced from Mathlib, same commit as the IVT stream above -- full transitive dependency closure of `IsCompact.exists_isMaxOn` (`IsCompact`, `ClosedIciTopology`, `IsMaxOn`, ...). All 2486 admitted declarations pass `Kernel::add_declaration` with ZERO declines.

reproduction_mathlib.working_directory: a mathlib4 checkout at the pinned commit (scripts/provision-lean-import-toolchain.sh), with lean4export built against the same toolchain
reproduction_mathlib.notes: Unlike the Init-only streams above, these two need a full mathlib4 build (oleans) and the module argument tells lean4export which file's namespace to resolve the declaration in; the exporter still emits only the requested constant's transitive dependency closure, not the whole module.
